steps.prompt_exact: Make a compact single-file HTML browser game called Mini Metro Signal Desk where I toggle colored track signals to route trains to matching stations without jams, with score, reset, and a phone-friendly layout.
steps.response_exact:
Now I'll build this — going for a dark industrial transit-ops aesthetic, compact enough for mobile, with satisfying toggle mechanics.

Mini Metro Signal Desk — here's how it plays:

Objective — colored arrow trains spawn from the edges and home in on their matching triangular station. Route them safely by controlling signals.

Controls — tap/click the 5 colored signal buttons at the bottom to toggle each line on/off. Turning a signal OFF halts all trains of that color mid-track (they flash !). Turn it back ON and they resume. Use this to sequence arrivals and prevent two trains hitting a congested station at once.

Scoring — each delivery = 10 pts, multiplied by your combo streak (shown next to the score). Combos build fast when you're juggling multiple lines smartly.

Lives — the 5 red dots in the top-right. You lose one when a stopped train waits too long OR a train escapes off-screen. Game ends at zero.

Difficulty — train speed and spawn rate ramp up with every delivery, so it gets tense fast.

steps.response_exact:
Three fixes needed: floor the score and combo before display, and add a visible countdown urgency indicator on stopped trains. Let me patch all three spots.

Now add the jam urgency indicator — a shrinking arc timer ring and red flash on the stopped train:

Three things fixed:

Score/combo decimals — score uses Math.floor() before writing to the DOM, combo display is always Math.floor(combo), and the decay logic no longer lets a fractional combo leak into the streak label.

Jam urgency indicator — stopped trains now show a countdown arc ring that drains clockwise around the train as the timer runs:

0–50% elapsed — dim !, ring in the train's own color
50–80% — amber ring, train fades/pulses more visibly
80–100% — train turns red, ring goes red, flashes !! rapidly, so you have a clear window to re-enable the signal before the life penalty hits
